name: CIC3Decimate4
adaptation: Retain the generic integrator/decimator/comb architecture, fix N=3, R=4, M=1, signed 16-bit samples and exact signed 22-bit output. Four logical samples form one transaction, with output at the fourth sample and zero prehistory. The explicit FIR definition fixes phase independently of the upstream pipeline. Internal modulo-32 arithmetic and the transaction schedule are BEHAVE adaptations; this is not cycle-exact reuse of cic_decimator.v.
